exposure: demographic factors (gravida, gestational age, mode of delivery, sex, birth weight)
cohort: The study enrolled 50 asphyxiated neonates at Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital.
finding: Clinical parameters such as seizures, ventilator requirement, and shock are critical indicators strongly associated with elevated Troponin I levels, suggesting myocardial injury in asphyxiated neonates.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no significant association with HIE severity (p = 0.507).
